$comment: Not on Windows, matching what CMakeLists.txt already decides:
GDRIVE_BUILD_UNIT_TESTS defaults OFF under MSVC because vcpkg
builds Catch2 against the dynamic CRT while DuckDB compiles our
sources against the static one (LNK2038), and find_package is
QUIET, so the test binary is simply not built there.
Installing it anyway cost a full Catch2 build on the one
platform that never uses it -- and on 2026-09-01 that build
started failing outright: it pulls msys2-runtime-3.5.4-2, which
msys2 has since removed from every mirror, so the pinned vcpkg
(2025-04-09) 404s and the whole Windows job dies in a
dependencies.name: catch2
